name: daily-expense-tracker
description: Full-stack daily expense tracker: React + Vite client, Express + PostgreSQL API.

scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client --include=dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix server && npm run format --prefix client
